members.name: tvg_paint_rel
members.brief: Safely releases a Tv_Paint object.
description: This is the counterpart to the `new()` API, and releases the given Paint object safely, handling `nullptr` and managing ownership properly.

params.name: paint
params.description: A paint object to release.

members.name: tvg_paint_ref
members.brief: Increment the reference count for the Tvg_Paint object.
description: This method increases the reference count of Tvg_Paint object, allowing shared ownership and control over its lifetime.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to increase the reference count.

members.returns: The updated reference count after the increment by 1.
warnings: Please ensure that each call to tvg_paint_ref() is paired with a corresponding call to tvg_paint_unref() to prevent a dangling instance.

members.name: tvg_paint_unref
members.brief: Decrement the reference count for the Tvg_Paint object.
description: This method decreases the reference count of the Tvg_Paint object by 1. If the reference count reaches zero and the `free` flag is set to true, the instance is automatically deleted.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to decrease the reference count.

params.name: free
params.description: Flag indicating whether to delete the Paint instance when the reference count reaches zero.

members.returns: The updated reference count after the decrement.

members.name: tvg_paint_get_ref
members.brief: Retrieve the current reference count of the Tvg_Paint object.
description: This method provides the current reference count, allowing the user to check the shared ownership state of the Tvg_Paint object.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to return the reference count.

members.returns: The current reference count of the Tvg_Paint object.

members.name: tvg_paint_set_visible
members.brief: Sets the visibility of the Paint object.
description: This is useful for selectively excluding paint objects during rendering.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to set the visibility status.

notes: An invisible object is not considered inactive—it may still participate in internal update processing if its properties are updated, but it will not be taken into account for the final drawing output. To completely deactivate a paint object, remove it from the canvas.

members.name: tvg_paint_get_visible
members.brief: Gets the current visibility status of the Paint object.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to return the visibility status.

members.returns: true if the object is visible and will be rendered. false if the object is hidden and will not be rendered.

members.name: tvg_paint_get_id
members.brief: Gets the ID of the Paint object.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object whose ID will be returned.

members.returns: The ID of the paint object, or 0 if the ID is not set.

members.name: tvg_paint_set_id
members.brief: Sets the ID of the Paint object.
description: The ID is used to specify a paint instance in a scene.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object whose ID will be set.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID to assign to the paint object.

members.name: tvg_paint_get_data
members.brief: Gets the user-defined data associated with the Paint object.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object whose user-defined data will be returned.

members.returns: The user-defined data, or `NULL` if none is set or `paint` is invalid.

members.name: tvg_paint_set_data
members.brief: Associates user-defined data with the Paint object.
description: ThorVG does not interpret or manage the lifetime of this data.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object whose user-defined data will be set.

params.name: data
params.description: The user-defined data to associate with the paint object.

members.name: tvg_paint_scale
members.brief: Scales the given Tvg_Paint object by the given factor.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to be scaled.

retvals.description: in case a custom transform is applied.

members.name: tvg_paint_translate

members.name: tvg_paint_set_opacity

notes: Setting the opacity with this API may require multiple renderings using a composition. It is recommended to avoid changing the opacity if possible.

members.brief: Gets the opacity of the given Tvg_Paint.

params.name: opacity

members.name: tvg_paint_intersects
members.signature: bool tvg_paint_intersects(Tvg_Paint paint, int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t w, int32_t h)
members.brief: Checks whether a given region intersects the filled area of the paint.
description: This function determines whether the specified rectangular region—defined by (`x`, `y`, `w`, `h`)— intersects the geometric fill region of the paint object.
This is useful for hit-testing purposes, such as detecting whether a user interaction (e.g., touch or click) occurs within a painted region.
The paint must be updated in a Canvas beforehand—typically after the Canvas has been drawn and synchronized.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to be tested.

params.name: x
params.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the test region.

params.name: y
params.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the test region.

params.name: w
params.description: The width of the region to test. Must be greater than 0.

params.name: h
params.description: The height of the region to test. Must be greater than 0.

members.returns: `true` if any part of the region intersects the filled area; otherwise, `false`.
notes: To test a single point, set the region size to w = 1, h = 1.
For efficiency, an AABB (axis-aligned bounding box) test is performed internally before precise hit detection.
This test does not take into account the results of blending or masking.
This test does take into account hidden paints as well.

members.name: tvg_paint_intersects_region
members.signature: bool tvg_paint_intersects_region(Tvg_Paint paint, int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t w, int32_t h, bool visibleOnly)
members.brief: Checks whether a given region intersects the filled area of the paint.
description: This function determines whether the specified rectangular region—defined by (`x`, `y`, `w`, `h`)— intersects the geometric fill region of the paint object.
This is useful for hit-testing purposes, such as detecting whether a user interaction (e.g., touch or click) occurs within a painted region.
The paint must be updated in a Canvas beforehand—typically after the Canvas has been drawn and synchronized.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to be tested.

params.name: x
params.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the test region.

params.name: y
params.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the test region.

params.name: w
params.description: The width of the region to test. Must be greater than 0.

params.name: h
params.description: The height of the region to test. Must be greater than 0.

params.name: visibleOnly
params.description: If `true`, hidden paints are excluded from the intersection test.

members.returns: `true` if any part of the region intersects the filled area; otherwise, `false`.
notes: To test a single point, set the region size to w = 1, h = 1.
This test does not take into account the results of blending or masking.

members.name: tvg_paint_get_aabb
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_paint_get_aabb(Tvg_Paint paint, float* x, float* y, float* w, float* h)
members.brief: Retrieves the axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) of the paint object in canvas space.
description: Returns the bounding box of the paint as an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB), with all relevant transformations applied. The returned values `x`, `y`, `w`, `h`, may have invalid if the operation fails. Thus, please check the retval.
This bounding box can be used to determine the actual rendered area of the object on the canvas, for purposes such as hit-testing, culling, or layout calculations.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object of which to get the bounds.

params.name: x
params.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding box.

params.name: y
params.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding box.

params.name: w
params.description: The width of the bounding box.

params.name: h
params.description: The height of the bounding box.

retvals.description: If it failed to compute the bounding box (mostly due to invalid path information).

members.name: tvg_paint_get_obb
members.brief: Retrieves the object-oriented bounding box (OBB) of the paint object in canvas space.
description: This function returns the bounding box of the paint, as an oriented bounding box (OBB) after transformations are applied. The returned values `pt4` may have invalid if the operation fails. Thus, please check the retval.

This bounding box can be used to obtain the transformed bounding region in canvas space by taking the geometry's axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) in the object's local coordinate space and applying the object's transformations.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object of which to get the bounds.

params.name: pt4
params.description: An array of four points representing the bounding box. The array size must be 4.

retvals.description: If it failed to compute the bounding box (mostly due to invalid path information).

members.name: tvg_paint_set_blend_method
members.brief: Sets the blending method for the paint object.
description: The blending feature allows you to combine colors to create visually appealing effects, including transparency, lighting, shading, and color mixing, among others. its process involves the combination of colors or images from the source paint object with the destination (the lower layer image) using blending operations. The blending operation is determined by the chosen `BlendMethod`, which specifies how the colors or images are combined.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object of which to set the blend method.

params.name: method
params.description: The blending method to be set.
